SET last_request_at = now()
WHERE id = 1

RETURNING last_request_at;

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO teachers_manager.book_ocr_usage_daily (teacher_id, usage_date, pages_count)
SELECT $1::uuid, CURRENT_DATE, $2::integer WHERE $2::integer <= $3::integer
ON CONFLICT (teacher_id, usage_date)
DO UPDATE SET pages_count = teachers_manager.book_ocr_usage_daily.pages_count + $2::integer
WHERE teachers_manager.book_ocr_usage_daily.pages_count + $2::integer <= $3::integer
RETURNING pages_count;
